milestone: fail-closed validator for the eventual bounded N0-N1 run contract
decision_changed: whether a proposed contract is structurally complete enough for implementation review and live resource preflight
scope: contract metadata only; no recording reads, hashes of large binaries, arm outcomes, launch, GPU allocation, sort, RF/holdout or C4 edits
required_bindings: exact d40c516e DARTsort source plus patch/import/environment hashes
one exact recording identity and content receipt
session clock, sampling rate, channels, geometry and padding
fixed motion-field path/hash/clock/sign and explicit half-open state bounds
common cohort/events and one shared N0 checkpoint per window
arms exactly N0 and N1 with segment ownership as the only intended delta
K10 v4 evaluator/review hashes and practical endpoint criteria
runtime, memory, disk, GPU and managed-service bounds
distinct create-only outputs, stop conditions and immutable failure preservation
negative_fixtures: missing practical loss bound or inconclusive-as-equivalence language
acceptance: author fixtures plus focused independent review before use on a real contract
claim_limit: metadata completeness only; validation does not prove referenced bytes, code behavior, resource readiness or scientific validity
